player_prompt.intro:
Udlala igemu leziqhulu ezibizwa ngokuthiwa Countdown!
Inhloso: Qhathanisa izibalo ngokusebenzisa +, -, *, / ukufikela inikeli.
Fomati yomkhuba: [i j op] lapho i,j zingamachaphungezi na op ingemongo.
Umbizo: [0 2 *] uqhomisa isibalo esichaphunwezi 0 nesibalo esichaphunwezi 2.
Ukugijima kufanele kuthathe izibalo ezingejonge.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ifomathi yenzo ayilunganga. Sebenzisa `[i j op]` apho i,j zii-indekhi na op yeyona +,-,*,/
invalid_move.invalid_indices: Iimpawu ezingekho mthethweni. Kufuneka zahluke kwaye zibe kuluhlu 0-{max_index}
invalid_move.invalid_operation: Umsebenzi ongasebenziyo (ukwahlulwa ngeziro okanye isiphumo esingaphelelanga)

outcome.turn_limit: Umgomo wenzo wezikhathi wafikiwe. Umphumela omhle: {best_value} (inqaku: {target})
